title: Nasi Lemak
description: Malaysia's national dish — fragrant coconut rice served with crispy anchovies, roasted peanuts, boiled egg, cucumber and spicy sambal.
steps: Wash rice and soak for 30 minutes
Cook rice with coconut milk, pandan leaves and salt
Roast peanuts in a dry pan
Boil eggs for 8 minutes then peel
Serve rice with all accompaniments and sambal

title: Rendang Daging
description: A rich and aromatic slow-cooked Malaysian beef dish with coconut milk and a blend of lemongrass, galangal and chillies.
steps: Blend chilli, onion, garlic, lemongrass and galangal into a paste
Add beef and cook until browned
Add coconut milk and bring to boil
Simmer on low heat for 1.5 hours stirring occasionally
Add kerisik and season with salt and sugar
Cook until gravy is dry and dark

title: Char Kway Teow
description: A popular Malaysian stir-fried flat rice noodle dish with prawns, Chinese sausage, bean sprouts and eggs cooked over high heat.
steps: Heat wok over high flame with oil
Season with soy sauce and dark soy sauce
Add bean sprouts and toss quickly

title: Laksa Lemak
description: A rich and spicy coconut milk based noodle soup with prawns, fish cake, tofu puffs and fresh laksa leaves.
steps: Blend lemongrass, chilli, garlic, onion, shrimp paste and turmeric
Add coconut milk and water, bring to simmer
Assemble bowl with noodles, toppings and hot broth
Garnish with laksa leaves and bean sprouts

title: Satay Ayam
description: Grilled skewered chicken marinated in turmeric and lemongrass, served with rich peanut sauce, ketupat and cucumber.
steps: Blend marinade with lemongrass, turmeric, garlic and shallots
Make peanut sauce by frying blended chilli paste
Add peanuts, coconut milk and tamarind

title: Mee Goreng Mamak
description: Indian-influenced Malaysian fried yellow noodles with tofu, potatoes, egg, bean sprouts in a spicy tomato and chilli sauce.
steps: Boil potato until soft then dice
Fry garlic and onion in hot wok
Add tomato sauce, chilli sauce and soy sauce
Add potato, tofu and bean sprouts

title: Ikan Bakar
description: Malaysian grilled fish marinated in sambal belacan, wrapped in banana leaf and grilled until charred and smoky.
steps: Mix sambal belacan with lemongrass, turmeric, lime juice, salt and sugar
Grill on both sides for 10-12 minutes each
Serve with rice and fresh vegetables

title: Roti Canai
description: Flaky flatbread of Indian origin popular in Malaysia, served with dal curry or sambal for dipping.
steps: Mix flour, egg, butter, salt, sugar and condensed milk
Fold and flatten repeatedly to create layers
Cook on hot griddle with butter

title: Asam Pedas Ikan
description: A sour and spicy fish stew from Melaka made with tamarind, chilli and torch ginger flower.
steps: Blend chilli, lemongrass, garlic and onion
Add tamarind water and bring to boil
Add fish and cook for 10 minutes

title: Kuih Seri Muka
description: A traditional Malay two-layered kuih with glutinous rice base and pandan custard top.
steps: Steam glutinous rice with coconut milk and salt
Mix pandan juice, coconut milk, egg, flour and sugar

title: Pad Thai
description: Thailand's famous stir-fried rice noodle dish with shrimp, tofu, egg, bean sprouts and crushed peanuts in tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak noodles in warm water for 30 minutes
Toss with bean sprouts and spring onion

title: Tom Yum Goong
description: A hot and sour Thai prawn soup with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal and mushrooms.
steps: Add lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaves
Add prawns and cook for 3 minutes
Season with fish sauce and lime juice

title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: Silky poached chicken served over fragrant rice cooked in chicken broth, with ginger paste and dark soy sauce.
steps: Rub chicken with salt and ginger
Poach chicken in water with ginger and spring onion for 45 minutes
Remove chicken and cool in ice water
Fry garlic and ginger in chicken fat

title: Beef Bulgogi
description: Korean marinated barbecued beef with sesame, soy sauce, pear and spring onions — tender, sweet and savoury.
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain
Blend pear, garlic, ginger with soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar
Grill or pan fry on high heat
Garnish with spring onion and sesame seeds

title: Miso Ramen
description: Japanese noodle soup with rich miso broth, soft-boiled egg, chashu pork, bamboo shoots and nori.
steps: Make chashu by rolling and braising pork belly in soy sauce
Soft boil eggs and marinate in soy sauce
Make broth with chicken stock, miso, garlic and ginger
Assemble bowl with noodles and hot broth
Top with chashu, egg, bamboo shoots and nori

title: Green Curry Chicken
description: A fragrant Thai green curry with tender chicken, Thai eggplant and basil in creamy coconut milk.
steps: Fry green curry paste in oil until fragrant
Add coconut milk and bring to simmer
Add chicken and cook for 15 minutes
Add eggplant and kaffir lime leaves
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar

title: Dim Sum Har Gow
description: Delicate steamed prawn dumplings with translucent crystal skin — a Cantonese dim sum classic.
steps: Mix wheat starch and tapioca flour
Add boiling water and knead into dough
Season filling with sesame oil, salt and sugar
Roll dough thin and cut into circles

title: Bibimbap
description: Korean mixed rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables, beef, fried egg and gochujang chilli paste.
steps: Season and stir fry each vegetable separately
Arrange vegetables and beef over rice

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic Roman pasta with crispy pancetta, eggs, Pecorino Romano and black pepper — no cream needed.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water
Whisk eggs with cheese and black pepper
Add egg mixture and splash of pasta water
Toss quickly to create creamy sauce

title: Margherita Pizza
description: The classic Neapolitan pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil on a thin crispy crust.
steps: Mix flour, water, yeast and salt into dough
Bake at highest oven temperature for 12-15 minutes

title: Risotto ai Funghi
description: Creamy Italian arborio rice with wild mushrooms, white wine, Parmesan and butter — comfort food at its finest.
steps: Fry onion and garlic in butter and oil
Add mushrooms and cook until golden
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes
Add white wine and stir until absorbed
Add hot broth ladle by ladle stirring constantly
Continue for 20 minutes until rice is al dente

title: Osso Buco
description: Milanese braised veal shanks in white wine and vegetables topped with gremolata — a northern Italian classic.
steps: Brown in olive oil on all sides
Add broth and braise for 1.5 hours
Make gremolata with lemon zest, parsley and garlic

title: Tiramisu
description: The iconic Italian dessert with espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.
steps: Brew strong espresso and let cool
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale
Repeat layers and dust with cocoa

title: Penne Arrabbiata
description: Fiery Italian pasta with garlic, tomatoes and chilli flakes — simple, bold and delicious.
steps: Cook penne in salted boiling water
Fry garlic and chilli flakes in olive oil
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes
Drain pasta and add to sauce
Toss and serve with parsley and Parmesan

title: Lasagna al Forno
description: Classic baked Italian lasagna with layers of beef bolognese, creamy béchamel and pasta sheets topped with golden Parmesan.
steps: Make bolognese with beef, onion, garlic, tomatoes and wine
Make béchamel with butter, flour and milk

title: Classic Beef Burger
description: Juicy homemade beef patty with lettuce, tomato, pickles, onion and special sauce in a brioche bun.
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper
Grill or pan fry on high heat 3-4 minutes each side
Mix special sauce with mayo, ketchup and mustard

title: BBQ Baby Back Ribs
description: Fall-off-the-bone pork baby back ribs slow cooked then finished on the grill with sticky smoky BBQ sauce.
steps: Wrap in foil and bake at 150°C for 2.5 hours
Mix BBQ sauce with vinegar and sugar
Unwrap ribs and brush with sauce
Grill for 15 minutes turning and basting

title: Mac and Cheese
description: Ultra creamy American baked macaroni and cheese with a three-cheese sauce and golden breadcrumb topping.
steps: Make roux with butter and flour
Add milk and whisk until smooth
Add cheeses and stir until melted
Season with garlic powder and mustard powder

title: New England Clam Chowder
description: Thick and creamy American soup with clams, potatoes, onion, celery and bacon in a rich cream base.
steps: Sauté onion and celery in butter
Season and serve with oyster crackers

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
description: Crispy Southern fried chicken marinated in buttermilk and coated in seasoned flour for maximum crunch.
steps: Marinate chicken in buttermilk for 4 hours

title: Caesar Salad
description: The classic American salad with crispy romaine lettuce, homemade Caesar dressing, croutons and shaved Parmesan.
steps: Make croutons by tossing bread with garlic oil and baking
Whisk egg yolk, garlic, anchovy, lemon juice and Worcestershire
Slowly whisk in olive oil to emulsify

title: New York Cheesecake
description: Dense and creamy classic New York style baked cheesecake with a graham cracker crust and fresh berry topping.
steps: Crush graham crackers and mix with butter
Beat cream cheese with sugar until smooth
Add eggs one at a time
Add sour cream, vanilla and lemon zest
Bake in water bath at 160°C for 65 minutes
Cool in oven with door ajar

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender grilled chicken in a rich, creamy and mildly spiced tomato-based curry sauce — a British-Indian favourite.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours
Fry onion in butter until golden

title: Beef Tacos
description: Mexican street-style soft tacos with seasoned ground beef, salsa, guacamole, sour cream and cheddar in corn tortillas.
steps: Cook beef mince with onion and garlic
Season with cumin, chilli powder and paprika
Make guacamole with avocado, lime and coriander
Top with guacamole, sour cream and cheese

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
description: Quick and healthy Chinese-style stir fry with mixed vegetables in garlic oyster sauce.
steps: Cut all vegetables into similar sizes
Mix oyster sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornstarch

title: French Onion Soup
description: Classic French bistro soup with caramelised onions in rich beef broth topped with crusty bread and melted Gruyere.
steps: Cook onions in butter on low heat for 45 minutes until caramelised
Add broth, thyme and bay leaf

title: Eggs Benedict
description: Brunch classic with poached eggs and Canadian bacon on an English muffin topped with rich hollandaise sauce.
steps: Make hollandaise by whisking yolks over bain marie
Slowly add melted butter whisking constantly
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar for 3 minutes

title: Mushroom Omelette
description: A fluffy French-style omelette filled with sauteed mushrooms, cheese and fresh herbs.
steps: Sauté mushrooms in butter until golden
Whisk eggs with cream, salt and pepper
Add egg mixture and let set on edges
Add mushrooms and cheese to one side
Slide onto plate and garnish with chives

title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon Butter
description: Pan-seared salmon fillet with crispy skin in lemon butter sauce with capers and dill.
steps: Heat oil in pan until smoking
Cook salmon skin side down for 5 minutes
Add butter, garlic, capers and lemon to pan

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, romaine lettuce, Parmesan and Caesar dressing wrapped in a warm flour tortilla.
steps: Season chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper
Grill chicken for 5 minutes each side
Fill tortilla with lettuce and chicken

title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
description: Italian grilled bread topped with fresh tomatoes, garlic, basil and extra virgin olive oil.
steps: Dice tomatoes and drain excess liquid
Mix with torn basil, olive oil and balsamic

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Individual warm chocolate cakes with a gooey molten centre, served with vanilla ice cream.
steps: Whisk eggs and yolks with sugar until thick
Butter ramekins and dust with cocoa
Turn out onto plate and serve immediately

title: Beef Pho
description: Vietnamese aromatic beef noodle soup with star anise, cinnamon and charred ginger in a rich bone broth.
steps: Char ginger and onion over flame
Simmer bones with charred ginger, onion and spices for 3 hours
Strain broth and season with fish sauce and sugar
Add raw beef and pour hot broth over

title: Shakshuka
description: Middle Eastern eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce with cumin and paprika — perfect for brunch.
steps: Fry onion and capsicum in olive oil
Add tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes
Season with salt and chilli flakes
Cover and cook until whites are set

title: Beef Stew
description: Hearty comfort food stew with tender beef chunks, potatoes, carrots and pearl onions in rich red wine broth.
steps: Cube beef and season with salt and pepper
Dredge in flour and brown in butter
Add broth, thyme and bay leaf
Braise on low heat for 1.5 hours

title: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
description: Fluffy American-style buttermilk pancakes served with warm maple syrup, butter and fresh berries.
steps: Fold wet into dry until just combined
Heat buttered pan over medium heat
Serve with maple syrup and berries

title: Beef Bolognese
description: A slow-cooked Italian meat sauce with ground beef, tomatoes, red wine and a hint of cream — perfect with tagliatelle.
steps: Finely dice onion, carrot and celery
Sauté in olive oil until soft
Cook tagliatelle and serve with sauce and Parmesan

title: Vegetable Curry
description: A warming and aromatic vegetarian curry with chickpeas, potatoes and spinach in a spiced tomato coconut sauce.
steps: Add garlic, ginger and all spices
Add coconut milk and simmer 20 minutes
Season and serve with rice or naan

title: Sushi Rolls
description: Japanese maki rolls with seasoned sushi rice, fresh salmon, avocado and cucumber wrapped in nori.
steps: Cook sushi rice and season with vinegar, sugar and salt
Slice salmon, avocado and cucumber into strips
Place nori shiny side down on bamboo mat
Spread rice over nori leaving 2cm border
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi

title: Prawn Nasi Goreng
description: Indonesian-style fried rice with prawns, egg, shrimp paste, kecap manis and crispy shallots.
steps: Fry shallots until crispy and set aside
Season with kecap manis and soy sauce

title: Banana Foster
description: New Orleans classic dessert with caramelised bananas in butter, brown sugar and rum sauce, served over vanilla ice cream.
steps: Add banana halves and cook 2 minutes
Tilt pan to ignite rum carefully

title: Gado Gado
description: Indonesian salad of boiled vegetables, tofu, tempeh and hard boiled egg with rich peanut sauce dressing.
steps: Fry tofu and tempeh until golden
Make peanut sauce by blending peanuts with coconut milk, chilli and garlic
Season peanut sauce with lime and kecap manis

title: Chicken Quesadilla
description: Crispy flour tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, melted cheddar, peppers and onions, served with salsa and sour cream.
steps: Season and cook chicken with spices
Add cheese, chicken and vegetables to one half
Cook until golden on both sides
Serve with salsa and sour cream

title: Tom Kha Gai
description: Thai coconut galangal chicken soup with lemongrass, mushrooms and kaffir lime — creamy, fragrant and slightly sour.
steps: Season with fish sauce and lime juice

title: Beef Kebab
description: Middle Eastern spiced ground beef kebabs with parsley, onion and cumin, grilled on skewers and served with flatbread.
steps: Grate onion and squeeze out moisture
Mix beef with onion, garlic, herbs and spices
Grill on high heat 4-5 minutes each side
Serve in flatbread with tomato, cucumber and yogurt

title: Pumpkin Soup
description: Velvety smooth roasted pumpkin soup with coconut milk, ginger and a swirl of cream.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in butter
Serve with cream and pumpkin seeds

title: Banana Bread
description: Moist and tender banana bread with walnuts and cinnamon — the perfect way to use overripe bananas.
